title: Codex Build Week
description: A mined and human-curated Hapa Set of Turn, Skill, Capability, and Protocol Cards derived from attributed Codex work between July 13 and July 20, 2026.

source.claimBoundary: Curated prototype Set. Raw Codex turns remain the attributed evidence; Cards are reversible projections, not replacements for source history.

cards.title: The Wisdom Studio Opens
cards.meaning: A raw card collection becomes a working, novel-scale studio where AI and human collaborators can distill, evaluate, storyboard, and revise enduring narrative structures.
cards.reversedMeaning: A beautiful interface that only performs placeholder reasoning or loses the Card evidence behind its advice.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human figure as the luminous keeper of a vast celestial writing studio, with orbiting wisdom cards, a glowing manuscript river, and modular story constellations. Hapa tarot illustration, cyan and magenta light, clear central subject, no letters or readable text.

cards.title: The Echo Album Forge
cards.meaning: The album director becomes a repeatable media forge: diverse Hapa assets flow through editing, render truth, explicit minting, and inspectable delivery rather than one-off cuts.
cards.reversedMeaning: A render that looks finished but cannot prove its source, final artifact, or mint boundary.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human figure at a mythic audiovisual forge where song waves become film strips, cards, and a single verified golden artifact. Hapa tarot illustration, neon crimson, teal, and gold, dynamic machinery, no letters or readable text.

cards.title: The Language Garden
cards.meaning: Multilingual source material grows into Meaning Cards, compact query sidecars, learning loops, and recoverable local knowledge without surrendering the original corpus.
cards.reversedMeaning: Translation flattened into detached labels with no source bytes, learning state, or recovery path.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human figure as a gardener of multilingual meaning, tending luminous glyph-seeds that grow into branching semantic cards and mirrored speech constellations. Hapa tarot illustration, violet, turquoise, and leaf green, no readable text.

cards.title: The Identity Forge
cards.meaning: Krea 2 and an identity adapter become a narrow, local Apple MLX node with a protected contract, measured presets, durable tasks, filtering, and proposal-based results.
cards.reversedMeaning: A demo that hides upstream ownership, bypasses consent, or calls generated similarity identity truth.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human figure inside a protected local identity forge: one warm Apple-silicon core, ordered reference light, a sealed task queue, and a provisional image emerging for review. Hapa tarot illustration, red, cobalt, and silver, no text.

cards.title: Card-Guided Distillation
cards.meaning: Extract structured answers from long-form material, preserve uncertainty, and let relevant Cards challenge or enhance each modular conclusion.
cards.reversedMeaning: Summaries presented as understanding without evidence, dissent, or traceable Card use.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human explorer as a precise distiller of a towering manuscript, separating evidence crystals, unanswered questions, and reusable wisdom cards into clear vessels. Hapa tarot illustration, blue glass, amber sparks, no letters or readable text.

cards.title: Render Truth Preflight
cards.meaning: Inspect every source, codec, shader, graph, and final artifact before expensive work begins; separate a foundation reel from the actual mintable composition.
cards.reversedMeaning: Fixing failures one video at a time while the systemic incompatibility remains invisible.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human explorer as a media preflight navigator examining a branching film path through codec gates, shader prisms, audio waves, and one certified final artifact. Hapa tarot illustration, sapphire and gold, no readable text.

cards.title: Four-Count Scene Reading
cards.meaning: Read a verified four-beat interval through lyrics, verbs, symbols, references, characters, and energy before proposing a single keyframe composition.
cards.reversedMeaning: Treating four counts as four seconds or rotating generic templates through a song.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human explorer conducting four luminous beats that unfold into lyrics, action symbols, character silhouettes, and one decisive cinematic keyframe. Hapa tarot illustration, rhythmic blue, pink, and gold light, no text.

cards.title: The Heuristic Lantern
cards.meaning: Audit whether claimed model reasoning actually occurred, expose deterministic shortcuts, and preserve the rejected artifact as learning evidence.
cards.reversedMeaning: A template engine wearing the language of interpretation.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human explorer holding a bright diagnostic lantern between a living reasoning tree and a repeating mechanical stencil, revealing the difference clearly. Hapa tarot illustration, deep blue, white, and warning orange, no readable text.

cards.title: Novel-Scale Wisdom
cards.meaning: A local studio can ingest long work, maintain modular character, scene, plot, timeline, and narrative answers, and append Card-derived Experience over time.
cards.reversedMeaning: Whole-document rewrites that erase provenance and make every change indivisible.
cards.instruction: Transform this synthetic observatory into a novel-scale wisdom engine: a long glowing manuscript winds through modular character, scene, plot, and timeline chambers beneath a constellation of cards. Hapa tarot illustration, emerald, cyan, and gold, no text.

cards.title: Pocket Cinema
cards.meaning: Editable Echo cuts can freeze a canonical vertical profile, certify 1080×1920 delivery, and preserve high-quality cards through working-copy, render, and mint paths.
cards.reversedMeaning: A phone crop that is merely a landscape render hidden behind a tall frame.
cards.instruction: Transform this synthetic observatory into a towering pocket cinema, with a true vertical beam, editable film layers, mobile framing guides, and a certified portrait artifact rising through the roof. Hapa tarot illustration, green, neon pink, and gold, no letters.

cards.title: The Endless Keyframe Loom
cards.meaning: A durable album process can claim one missing four-count at a time, generate its prompt and image, pause safely, resume, and continue until coverage is complete.
cards.reversedMeaning: An unbounded batch with no durable claims, recovery, or honest completion state.
cards.instruction: Transform this synthetic observatory into an endless celestial loom weaving one cinematic keyframe for every four-beat star, with visible queued, active, paused, and completed constellations. Hapa tarot illustration, emerald and electric blue, no text.

cards.title: Local Identity Restage
cards.meaning: A consent-aware Hapa app can submit ordered references to one protected local MLX worker and receive a filtered, content-addressed edit proposal with provenance.
cards.reversedMeaning: Browser-held credentials, hidden remote custody, or silent substitution of an unsupported image operation.
cards.instruction: Transform this synthetic observatory into a protected local identity-restage station with ordered reference portals, one warm worker, a safety prism, and a content-addressed proposal returning to a card. Hapa tarot illustration, green, cobalt, and silver, no text.

cards.title: Bootstrap Without Burden
cards.meaning: A trusted local Hapa app establishes its own scoped session and safe defaults; the operator is not asked to copy bearer tokens or choose internal runtime paths.
cards.reversedMeaning: Security theater that transfers secret handling and implementation details to the user.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human mascot as a welcoming protocol guardian who opens one safe local gate automatically while bearer keys remain sealed behind the wall. Hapa tarot illustration, jade, cyan, and warm gold, no letters or readable text.

cards.title: Pause, Resume, Complete
cards.meaning: Long-running creative work advances through durable bounded claims, explicit pause and resume, monotonic state, cancellation recovery, and a measurable completion condition.
cards.reversedMeaning: A process that must remain watched because stopping loses its place or duplicates work.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human mascot beside a great circular work wheel with clear resting, moving, paused, recovered, and completed phases, each step preserving its place. Hapa tarot illustration, green, violet, and gold, no readable text.

cards.title: Proposal Is Not Truth
cards.meaning: Generated identity media remains provisional, filtered, source-preserving, visibly AI-generated, and subject to human acceptance before promotion or publication.
cards.reversedMeaning: A generated resemblance silently promoted into canon, mint, or identity authority.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human mascot presenting a luminous image inside an unmistakable review frame, while the untouched source remains safe beside it and a human approval gate waits ahead. Hapa tarot illustration, jade, red, and silver, no text.

cards.title: Raw Turn, Derived Card
cards.meaning: Keep exact user and model messages source-separated; every reusable Card points back to the mined Turn, and every downstream artifact registers that creation relationship.
cards.reversedMeaning: A polished lesson that erases the prompt, response, correction, model, or source file that made it possible.
cards.instruction: Restage this synthetic non-human mascot tending an immutable archive of raw conversation scrolls that branch into luminous derived cards, each joined by visible golden lineage threads. Hapa tarot illustration, green, cyan, and archival gold, no readable text.
